claims: Club América defeated Philadelphia Union 2-1 on aggregate in the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup Round of 16.
Philadelphia Union 0-1 Club América in the first leg on March 10.
Raphael Veiga scored in the 20th minute of the first leg.
Club América 1-1 Philadelphia Union in the second leg on March 18.
Rodrigo Dourado scored in the 6th minute of the second leg.
Jesús Bueno scored a penalty in the 49th minute of the second leg.
Club América advanced to the quarterfinals.
